name: WayriCAD Quick PI
description: Local 2.5D power-integrity simulation with source/sink terminals, copper meshes and native result views.
description_full: Solve DC voltage drop, current density and Joule loss on actual filled traces, pads, zones and plated via barrels. Inspect net geometry, conforming mesh and field results in a native window; export a self-contained HTML report. A separate QuickTherm action opens the saved-board thermal screening workspace for mapped component dissipation, optional layered copper and mounting boundaries. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy, VTK and Matplotlib is required. These are screening models, not full-wave AC or coupled electrothermal solvers.
